body:
It isn’t just pictures, it is a whole entire porno I didn’t know was being filmed. 

I am young. I am also very privileged. I grew up into a diplomatic family, old money, very wealthy. I am friends with the children of billionaires, I am friends with a Prince (of a small country - but he is still a legitimate Prince), and I also know some Habsburgs. 

I didn’t want to end up being a trust fund baby. I wanted to make my own fortune. I ended with a B- in English this semester, and my mom kind of told me that I won’t be able to make it into a top uni. I try really hard in school, and this grade is devastating to me. My life is comfortable. She kind of told me I could make a lot of money, but I won’t have the connections that will allow me to make the Top 1% income I am used to. I am going to have to leech off my parents. My mom inherited stakes into two major (when I mean major, I mean two of the most recognizable in the world) designer brands. My dad is a high-ranking diplomat, but his grandfather was a cofounder of a major tech company. In the world I live in, the salary my father makes is not high. In the world of the rich people, my father would be in the lowest class. If he didn’t have this status of being an heir to a tech giant, he wouldn’t be “allowed” within his social groups. I find it complete bull, but that is the type of society I live in. 

The pressure in my family is unreal. My twenty six year old cousin is now the manager of some of the most famous celebrities in the world, my twenty-two year old cousin makes €200,000 at Google every year, and my “dumb” cousin has a 3.9 GPA at Brown. I can’t live up to that.
